skill.name: vueuse-functions
skill.description: Select and apply documented VueUse composables for Vue 3 and Nuxt 3 features, including lifecycle, SSR, browser, and dependency considerations.
skill.summary: Choose the right VueUse composable and apply its documented Vue 3 or Nuxt 3 usage pattern.
skill.author: antfu

security_audit.summary: All 400 presented static findings are false positives caused by Markdown formatting, TypeScript declarations, relative documentation paths, and legitimate VueUse examples. Keyboard examples handle user-interface events without recording or transmitting input, while network examples use documentation endpoints or caller-provided URLs. No prompt injection or malicious intent was found in the reviewed files. Static review was capped at 400/1259 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 859 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.

content.value_statement: Choosing the right VueUse composable can be difficult across a large API. This skill maps Vue or Nuxt requirements to documented composables and usage patterns.
actual_capabilities: Maps Vue and Nuxt requirements to VueUse functions organized by feature category.
Distinguishes automatic, external dependency, and explicit-only invocation rules.
Consults per-function references containing usage guidance and TypeScript declarations.
Provides patterns for state, browser, sensor, network, animation, and reactivity features.
Identifies when a composable requires an additional package or framework integration.
limitations: Requires a Vue 3 or Nuxt 3 project.
Provides implementation guidance but does not execute or test the resulting project.
Reference content may differ from the VueUse version installed in a project.
Browser APIs still require runtime support, permissions, and appropriate user consent.

use_cases.title: Replace custom Vue utilities
use_cases.description: Match event, state, and reactivity requirements with maintained VueUse composables.

use_cases.title: Plan SSR-compatible features
use_cases.description: Select Nuxt-compatible patterns for responsive state, lifecycle behavior, and browser-only APIs.

use_cases.title: Standardize composable usage
use_cases.description: Review feature implementations for consistent VueUse choices and dependency requirements.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a composable
prompt_templates.prompt: Choose a VueUse composable for [requirement] in my Vue 3 component. Explain why it fits and show the minimal usage.
prompt_templates.scenario: Select one documented composable for a focused feature.

prompt_templates.title: Implement a Nuxt feature
prompt_templates.prompt: Implement [feature] in this Nuxt 3 component using VueUse. Check SSR behavior, cleanup, browser support, and required permissions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Build a complete feature with runtime constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Refactor a custom utility
prompt_templates.prompt: Refactor this custom Vue utility with suitable VueUse composables. Preserve behavior, identify dependency changes, and explain any tradeoffs.
prompt_templates.scenario: Replace bespoke reactive logic with maintained composables.

prompt_templates.title: Design an integrated workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a VueUse approach for [workflow]. Compare candidate composables, define lifecycle and error handling, then provide production-ready integration steps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Plan an advanced feature using several composables.

output_examples.input: Add Escape key handling that closes a Vue dialog.
output_examples.output: Recommends onKeyStroke with an Escape filter, scoped dialog state, and automatic listener cleanup.

output_examples.input: Share asynchronous profile state across several Vue components.
output_examples.output: Combines shared state and asynchronous state composables, then explains loading, error, and refresh behavior.

output_examples.input: Make Nuxt breakpoints render consistently on server and client.
output_examples.output: Recommends responsive breakpoint handling with an SSR width strategy to reduce hydration differences.

best_practices: State the framework, installed VueUse version, and relevant project constraints.
Confirm external dependencies before selecting integration composables.
Verify SSR behavior, browser permissions, lifecycle cleanup, and error handling.
anti_patterns: Do not force a composable when native Vue code is clearer and sufficient.
Do not add optional dependencies without confirming project requirements.
Do not use browser or sensor APIs without support checks and user consent.

faq.question: Which projects can use this skill?
faq.answer: It targets Vue 3 and Nuxt 3 projects that can use VueUse composables.

faq.question: Does the skill install VueUse or other packages?
faq.answer: No. It identifies required packages and expects installation to follow project approval.

faq.question: How does it choose a composable?
faq.answer: It maps the requirement to a function category, checks invocation rules, and consults the matching reference.

faq.question: Can it help with server-side rendering?
faq.answer: Yes. It can identify SSR considerations, but the generated implementation still requires project testing.

faq.question: Does it support external VueUse integrations?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses them only when the required dependency is already available or explicitly approved.

faq.question: How should sensitive browser APIs be handled?
faq.answer: Check browser support, request clear user consent, minimize collected data, and handle denied permissions.
